about: A §18 primitive row generates no site in a generated-area row of the layer table (area generated, knip's ignore too): the generated code's source holds the primitive, so its ignores list that row after the test files; a rule file holding exactly those ignores is not drifted (contracts §18; 2.1-M189, 2.1-M218)

rules.note: ids are minted only by their minters
